SELECT movie_info_idx.id, info_type.info, MIN(movie_info_idx.info) FROM movie_info_idx, info_type WHERE movie_info_idx.id <> 1214182 AND info_type.id > 59 AND movie_info_idx.info >= '25' AND movie_info_idx.movie_id > 2300150 AND movie_info_idx.info_type_id = 100 GROUP BY movie_info_idx.id, info_type.info

SELECT title.id, movie_info_idx.info_type_id, comp_cast_type.kind, complete_cast.id, SUM(complete_cast.subject_id) FROM movie_info_idx JOIN title ON title.id = movie_info_idx.movie_id JOIN complete_cast ON complete_cast.movie_id = title.id JOIN comp_cast_type ON comp_cast_type.id = complete_cast.status_id WHERE movie_info_idx.info < '2..11111.3' AND title.season_nr > 3 GROUP BY title.id, movie_info_idx.info_type_id, comp_cast_type.kind, complete_cast.id HAVING SUM(complete_cast.subject_id) > 1

select movie_keyword.id, title.series_years, title.season_nr from cast_info JOIN title ON title.id = cast_info.movie_id JOIN movie_keyword ON movie_keyword.movie_id = title.id where cast_info.person_role_id > 2177998 AND cast_info.person_id <= 3506837 AND cast_info.role_id = 9 order by title.season_nr DESC

select complete_cast.movie_id, movie_keyword.keyword_id, comp_cast_type.kind, comp_cast_type.id from movie_keyword JOIN title ON title.id = movie_keyword.movie_id JOIN complete_cast ON complete_cast.movie_id = title.id JOIN comp_cast_type ON comp_cast_type.id = complete_cast.status_id where comp_cast_type.id >= 2 AND title.episode_nr > 48 AND title.episode_nr <= 29

select title.episode_nr, movie_info.id, movie_link.linked_movie_id from movie_link JOIN title ON title.id = movie_link.movie_id JOIN movie_info ON movie_info.movie_id = title.id where title.phonetic_code <= 'H3162' AND title.kind_id >= 2 AND title.title >= 'Die Todeszeche' AND movie_info.info_type_id < 105 AND title.md5sum = '438afc197bf5adfc49019f0496a3797e'

SELECT title.season_nr, company_name.name_pcode_nf, movie_info_idx.id, movie_companies.company_id, AVG(movie_companies.movie_id) FROM movie_info_idx JOIN title ON title.id = movie_info_idx.movie_id JOIN movie_companies ON movie_companies.movie_id = title.id JOIN company_name ON company_name.id = movie_companies.company_id WHERE movie_info_idx.id > 526904 AND movie_companies.id < 1765864 GROUP BY title.season_nr, company_name.name_pcode_nf, movie_info_idx.id, movie_companies.company_id HAVING AVG(movie_companies.movie_id) > 1951183 ORDER BY company_name.name_pcode_nf DESC, title.season_nr DESC

select title.season_nr, movie_link.link_type_id, link_type.id, movie_companies.note, max(title.episode_of_id) from link_type JOIN movie_link ON movie_link.link_type_id = link_type.id JOIN title ON title.id = movie_link.movie_id JOIN movie_companies ON movie_companies.movie_id = title.id where movie_link.id > 23398 AND movie_companies.note = '(1914) (USA) (theatrical)' group by title.season_nr, movie_link.link_type_id, link_type.id, movie_companies.note order by movie_companies.note DESC, title.season_nr DESC, movie_link.link_type_id ASC

select title.md5sum, movie_info.movie_id, link_type.id, movie_link.id from movie_info JOIN title ON title.id = movie_info.movie_id JOIN movie_link ON movie_link.movie_id = title.id JOIN link_type ON link_type.id = movie_link.link_type_id where title.imdb_index = 'I' AND title.id >= 1103840 AND title.production_year < 1986 order by movie_link.id ASC
